name: FELL (LEAN)
one_line: CORRIE's sim-proven box shell, 3 % shallower, in ULTRAGrid / 70D / ULTRA 200X: roll-top first, one straight 540 mm #10 zip, W1-W3 as compression, and G-hook add-on pods on 8 seam hard points that only go on when the loadout needs them.
pack_mass_M_note: 3943 - 716.5 (CORRIE B.2 bag system, same code: body group + IMP-1/2/4/8 + re-cut fly + fly pocket) + 583.1 (FELL, max config: all 4 add-ons). Day config 3671.6 g.
volume_note: cloth sim fill case (68 kg), mean of 15/19/23 in; lid pod 2.7 L extra, not counted
cg_note: coarse (h 40 mm) cloth sims fell_PR15/19/23 on corrie_PR*c settings, with the 1 kg lid pod on the roll and the 85 mm spotter on the left side (mass-weighted CG incl. both). Rounding stage per case in analysis/bag_comp_lean.md; add <= 4 mm for rounding bias.
features: Roll-top main closure (70D collar, ULTRAGrid hem, ULTRA 200 frame-side strip under the hood ladders)
One straight #10 coil zip, 540 mm, z 110-650 in the aft centre seam: IM1-IM3 and low gear; 1 slider, camo garage
No wings: W1/W2 haul wraps do the carry compression (their documented carry-mode job); unhook to open the zip
8 hard-point webbing loops in the corner seams (z 260 / 490) for G-hook add-ons
A1 glass pod: padded 85 mm spotter sleeve on its own panel, cinches like a wing (left)
A2 side strap pair: tripod / poles / jacket, tripod feet in the cam cup (right)
A3 lid pod 2.7 L on the roll (optional)
A4 strap pod (snacks / GPS) on the right J-strap: fixes CORRIE's S-L snack miss
Hydration sleeve (CORRIE IMP-2 geometry, 70D) + hose ports; cam / tripod-foot cup; fly in the base pocket
Owner camo: V-notch kick band, pod leading-edge bar, zip garage, lid-pod tab, strap-pod binding
Frame interface unchanged (hood B-19, B-20, B-22, IM hooks, hinge pins, B-24, US1/US2, IM1-IM3, fairleads)
risks: Fabric gates: ULTRAGrid needs the owner's swatch approval (visible grid); ULTRA 200X floor needs PT-3 + a 50 mm strip test (strip strength unpublished); 70D collar: weigh the Robic stock first
Durability: ULTRAGrid only matches 330D on abrasion (Taber 1100 vs ~950-1070) and is ~55-60 % of 500D; the 70D collar tears at 37-52 N; this is a lighter, not a tougher, bag
Noise: ULTRA 200X floor is a film laminate (quietness 2/5 in the record); the floor rarely brushes vegetation, but it can crinkle when set down or packed
Access: a straight slit opens narrower than CORRIE's horseshoe, and W1/W2 must be unhooked to open it (two G-hooks); no door pocket: the kill kit packs mid-aft behind the zip (packing rule)
Modules only save weight if they stay home; with every add-on fitted FELL saves 133 g, not the 271 g of the day config
Sheep 8-day: 1 hourly miss (2nd bottle) and glassing misses (poles, beanie, first aid light) because there is no door pocket and the side straps are full
G-hook add-ons can be lost in the field; spare G-hooks are cheap but are one more thing
Coarse-mesh CG (h 40 mm); 3 % shallower shell not yet checked against the hood / B-20 fit on a prototype
